title: gitbroker envelope v1
description: One PROPOSED CALL, committed by the far end into the bridge repo as commands/<ulid>.json. A public artifact: it must never carry a credential (auth_slot is a NAME the poller resolves host-side). The far end proposes; the authoritative side's Policy decides.

ulid.description: Id; also the file name. ULIDs sort by time, which is the poll order.

seq.description: The far end's monotonic sequence; a gap in receipts tells the far end something was lost.

agent.description: Who proposes — provenance across the boundary; declared as X-8-Actor on the fire.

atom.description: Git collapses CHANNEL into CALL: a bridge envelope is exactly one CALL. A channel op is proposed as a CALL to the witness (POST /run).

call.description: The CALL atom — identical to the wire's http_request shape (httpx.Request).

headers.description: Never Authorization / Proxy-Authorization / Cookie — Validate rejects them.

auth_slot.description: Name of a host-side credential (state/slots.json). The value never crosses the bridge.

not_after.description: A proposal that sat in git past this instant must not fire.

max_ms.description: Fire deadline hint in milliseconds; 0 = poller default.

why.description: Free text; echoed into the receipt.
